hypothesis: L013 and L018 showed that raw-target specialization of cluster2 was slightly harmful, but cluster2 contains no high-Tc rows and has comparatively low temperatures. A cluster2-only extra_trees/log1p expert may exploit that localized target distribution: prior global log1p models sharply reduced reported-zero error but damaged positive and high-Tc predictions, so restricting log1p to this no-high-Tc cluster could retain some zero-Tc benefit while containing the positive-Tc penalty. Cluster0 and cluster1 remain on the G01 extra_trees/raw fallback to isolate the target change.
falsification: The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted training OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K, representing at least the required 0.01 K gain over A05, and positive-Tc MAE is at most the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. A lower reported-zero or cluster2 MAE without both conditions is only a subgroup tradeoff.
reason: The required minimum is still pending at 18 of 22 successful unique cycles. This untried configuration completes a clean target-only comparison against L013 for cluster2 and tests whether the consistently observed log1p zero-versus-positive tradeoff becomes favorable when confined to a low-temperature route with no high-Tc cases.
